rows.text: a 'Performance Highlight' filing, baseline mis-bucketed as an allotment (filing text not in this pass's cache; carried from the baseline's own line, unread).

H1 FY27 revenue of Rs 72.27 cr, up 31.38% YoY, at 98.9% capacity utilisation; plans a 44% capacity addition at Sanand-II (Rs 65 cr, funded from IPO proceeds + promoter infusion), commercial production targeted Jan-2027.
